newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close lower on currency.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close lower on currency.

text.p: UK grain futures closed lower on Wednesday mainly on currency and a lack of buyers.
Wheat prices fell by one to 0.20 stg as the pound sterling maintained it's strength against other European currencies.
"While sterling remains strong and prices keep falling buyers are not going to jump in in case prices go even lower the following day," said a trader.
Barley finished 0.65 to 0.25 stg down with 91 lots traded.
Amsterdam milling wheat futures were again neglected.
UK cash grain traders reported little activity on the delivered market while in the fob sector Feb feed wheat traded at 99 stg, Apr at 100 stg and Apr/Jun at 101.25 stg all ex-east coast ports.
